Remark
[Alternate boundedness argument for $F$] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0282, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0283, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0284 1. Remark 9.14\group necklike-points-in-finite-time-singularities

The source records an alternate proof that $F$ remains bounded, using the enhanced maximum principle for systems and a directly controlled auxiliary quantity built from $\lambda -\nu $.
